## Fixes

**Customer & supplier balances survive restarts**
Balances were being wiped every time the app was closed and reopened (customer/supplier names stayed, balances came back as 0). A legacy opening-balance migration was re-running on every boot and overwriting `opening_balance`; it now runs exactly once, in the boot that creates the column. Existing databases are never touched again.

> Balances that were already zeroed before this update must be re-entered once (Edit customer / Edit supplier) — this build keeps them from then on. If the loss happened within the last 24 hours, an auto-backup snapshot from before the wipe can be restored via Data Management → Auto Backups.

**Sale returns now reduce Cost of Goods Sold**
Summary → Income Statement used to subtract the return revenue but never the cost of the returned goods, understating gross/net profit. Each sale-return line now stamps the product cost at return time, the returned stock is recorded in Stock History, and the cost is reversed out of COGS in the return's own period. Deleting a return reverses it fully.
